title: OpenWhispr — Per-Tenant Usage
description: Per-tenant usage rollups from the `usage_ledger` table. Operators see the same numbers `/api/usage` returns to the desktop client, aggregated across the tenant. Read-only Postgres datasource via the `grafana_reader` role.

targets.rawSql: SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, SUM(spend_cents) / 100.0 AS spend_usd, COUNT(*) AS request_count FROM usage_ledger WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY spend_usd DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, tenant_id::text AS metric, SUM(transcribe_minutes)::float AS value FROM usage_ledger WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, tenant_id::text AS metric, SUM(reason_tokens)::float AS value FROM usage_ledger WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, tenant_id::text AS metric, SUM(streaming_minutes)::float AS value FROM usage_ledger WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Active tenants (24h)
panels.description: Distinct tenant_id values present in usage_ledger over the last 24h.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tenant_id) AS active_tenants FROM usage_ledger WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
